# Mindfuels Publisher & Distributors

> Mindfuels is a children's educational book publisher in Sri Nagar, Delhi (110034), India, with 20 years of experience. It publishes practice worksheets, assignment workbooks, activity books, phonics, cursive and calligraphy books, rhymes, Hindi and English grammar, and classic story books for children from pre-nursery to Class 6. Books are sold online with free shipping across India.

Mindfuels books are used by parents, teachers and schools. The catalogue is organised by class or age group, by subject and by interest.

## Shop by class or age

- [2-4 years, Early Foundation (Pre Nursery & Nursery)](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?class=Early+Foundation+%28Pre+Nursery+%26+Nursery%29)
- [4-6 years, Kindergarten (L.K.G & U.K.G)](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?class=Kindergarten+Years+%28U.K.G+%26+L.K.G%29)
- [6-8 years, Lower Primary (Class 1 & 2)](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?class=Lower+Primary+%28Class+1+%26+2%29)
- [8-10 years, Upper Primary (Class 3 & 4)](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?class=Upper+Primary+%28Class+3+%26+4%29)
- [10-12 years, Middle School (Class 5 & 6)](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?class=Middle+School+%28Class+5+%26+6%29)

## Shop by subject

- [English](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?subject=English): grammar practice, unseen passages (comprehension) and English readers
- [Hindi](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?subject=Hindi): Hindi grammar (vyakaran), unseen passages (apathit gadyansh), textbooks and handwriting (sulekh)
- [Mathematics](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?subject=Mathematics): practice worksheets, tables, addition and subtraction
- [Science & Computer](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?subject=Science+%26+Computer): science, environmental studies, social studies and computer textbooks
- [Mental Ability & GK](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?subject=Mental+Ability+%26+GK): logical reasoning worksheets, brain boosters and general knowledge
- [All-in-One](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?subject=All-in-One): one practice book covering several subjects for a class

## Shop by interest

- [Story Books](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?interest=Story+Books): classics and short stories (Tagore, Premchand, Dickens, Kipling, O. Henry, Chekhov, Shakespeare and more), Hindi moral stories, and French and German readers
- [Rhymes & Poems](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?interest=Rhymes+%26+Poems): English rhymes and Hindi bal geet and poems
- [Activity Books](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?interest=Activity+Books): early learning, matching, mazes, word search and wipe-and-clean flash cards
- [Calligraphy & Cursive](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?interest=Calligraphy+%26+Cursive): handwriting practice by level
- [Art & Creativity](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?interest=Art+%26+Creativity): art and craft, colouring and mandala books
- [Phonetics](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products?interest=Phonetics): English and Hindi phonic sounds

## Ordering and policies

- [All books](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/products)
- [Shipping, returns, privacy and contact](https://mindfuelspublisher.com/legal_pages)
- Shipping: free on every order, packed and dispatched by the Mindfuels team.
- Returns: a damaged, defective or incorrect copy can be replaced or refunded if reported within 7 days of delivery.
- Payment: UPI, cards and net banking, through Razorpay.
